args.lesson: Verdict STOP for Go-Hybrid #186. Observed: the issue is another party's Wildcard proposal (ledger W-011, author CarlitoDon); its $250 milestones would be paid to that author, one winner among 23 entries, verdict pending. What worked: reading the full issue body, the owner comment and BOUNTY.md/MOONSHOT.md (5 FETCHes) settled it without any implementation. What failed: the search snippet ('💎 Bounty', '$250', 0 assignees) made a proposal look like an open task. Next time: for a bounty-labelled issue, first check who wrote it and whether the money is offered BY the issue or requested THROUGH it. Scope-limited side fact: the same program's ladder ($45-75, reproduced soundness bugs, AI allowed) needs a GitHub account and a USDC-on-Base wallet, neither held; no external payout was observed; repo is one month old with 2070 open issues and 310 forks (heavy agent competition). This is one program's result, not a conclusion about all bounties.
